request.description:
Use this method to withdraw a pending policy waiver request that you originally submitted.

The request row is removed; this is intended for cleaning up requests created by mistake (wrong scope, wrong rationale, etc.). The action is recorded in the audit log so the withdrawal remains traceable. Only the original requester may withdraw, and only while the request is in the REQUESTED state. Once a request has been APPROVED or REJECTED, withdraw is rejected — those terminal states must be handled by a reviewer through the review endpoint.

Permissions required: View IQ Elements (the caller must also be the requester of the waiver request; other callers receive 404).
